name: Rhodium
description: Rhodium (Rh) thin films deposited by sputtering and evaporation — used for hard reflective coatings and electrical contacts. Targets: 99.99 %, 2 in.
description_ko: 스퍼터링·증발 증착으로 형성하는 로듐(Rh) 박막입니다. 고경도 반사 코팅·전기 접점에 활용됩니다. 타깃: 순도 99.99 %, 2 인치.
filmSpecs: Film-coated by DC magnetron sputtering vacuum < 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ Torr
Applications : High-Reflectivity Coatings, Catalytic Layers, Corrosion-Resistant Electrodes
